machine.title: Fingerprint time clock setup
machine.description: Bring time clock data into the software
machine.intro: To use a time clock for your store, follow these steps:
machine.step1: Enter each employee's Timekeeping code matching the ID (User ID / AC-No.) registered on the time clock.
machine.step2: On the time clock or its software, export attendance data to a CSV, TXT or Excel (.xlsx) file with Timekeeping code and Time (or Date + Time) columns.
machine.step3: Choose the file below. Each punch is matched to a shift: clock-in = earliest punch, clock-out = latest punch in the shift.

machine.unmatched_other: {count} punches didn't match any shift (outside shift hours)

tk.title: Timekeeping settings
tk.workHoursHint: Set the hours that count as workdays for the standard-workday salary type.
tk.standardHoursHint: Used to convert hours into workdays and to compute the overtime rate
tk.convertHint: On: daily hours count as a half or full day by the thresholds below; off: prorated by hours worked / standard hours
tk.markError: Full-day threshold must be greater than the half-day threshold
tk.lateEarlyForHalf: Record late arrival / early leave on half days
tk.lateEarlyHint: Set the grace period for arriving late or leaving early
tk.lateAfterHint: Clock-ins later than this many minutes count as late
tk.earlyBeforeHint: Clock-outs earlier than this many minutes count as leaving early
tk.overtimeHint: Count overtime when staff clock in early or clock out late
tk.otBeforeHint: Clock-ins earlier than this many minutes count as overtime
tk.otAfterHint: Clock-outs later than this many minutes count as overtime
tk.otActualAllHint: On: include time within the threshold; off: only time beyond it
tk.singleInOut: Allow one clock-in / out across consecutive shifts
tk.singleInOutHint: E.g. Shift 1 (7:00 - 12:00), Shift 2 (13:00 - 18:00). Clock in for shift 1 and clock out for shift 2 (QR or fingerprint); the system records shift 1 clock-out at 12:00 and shift 2 clock-in at 13:00
tk.autoHint: Staff don't need to clock in; the system records attendance for them
tk.unscheduledHint: Besides scheduled shifts, staff may clock in to shifts they weren't scheduled for.
